answer: Resistance via non-kin endorsement: an agent becomes eligible only when several independent peers, each a distinct vertex that shares no common invite lineage, vouch for its work. Picture a single identity as a lone marker on open tundra; isolated, it proves nothing. Sybils spawned from one parent form a tight cluster and cannot supply the cross-lineage signatures a quorum demands, so their counterfeit opal shine never clears the bar.
